reason: Induction on n. The cases r = 0 and r = n give the value 1. For 0 < r < n, a direct manipulation of the q-Pochhammer definition yields the recurrence G_{n,r} = G_{n-1,r} + q^{n-r} G_{n-1,r-1}. The induction hypothesis then gives polynomiality, and the second summand has strictly larger degree than the first, so the degree is exactly r(n-r), which also implies nonzeroness.
